{{Term/Store|Frelly||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Frelly|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Frelly|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Frelly is a [[Gerudo]] who manages the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth]] in [[Gerudo Town]].<ref name="Shop">{{Cite|My name is Frelly. I run a shop in Gerudo Town where I rent out {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> The [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Northwest Booth|Northwest Booth]] is managed by Frelly's mother, [[Kohm]].<ref name="Kohm"/> [[Link]] can first encounter Frelly in the [[Gerudo Desert]] just outside the front gate of Gerudo Town. When Link speaks to her, Frelly asks if Link crossed the Desert on foot.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, wow... Don't tell me you crossed the Gerudo Desert on foot?|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

If Link tells her that he came on foot, Frelly comments that it must have been difficult and that it is common sense to travel the Gerudo Desert with a [[Sand Seal]].<ref>{{Cite|Must have been hard to walk through the desert—especially having your feet sink into the sand. It's common sense to travel the desert with {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} around here.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> If Link says he rode there, Frelly is impressed that a [[Hylian]] man has mastered Sand Seal surfing.<ref>{{Cite|Wow... A Hylian voe who has mastered {{Color BotW|Blue|sand-seal}} surfing?|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> Frelly is speechless, pausing for a moment before saying that it must have been a challenge to catch a Sand Seal.<ref>{{Cite|I didn't think it was possible. I'm speechless! I think I may need a moment... Phew. Anyway... I bet it was a real challenge to catch a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}, wasn't it?|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

Frelly then introduces herself and explains that she rents out trained Sand Seals for people who do not have the time to train their own.<ref name="Shop"/><ref>{{Cite|Most people can't take the time to train their own {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}, so I rent out the ones I've trained!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> She assures Link that she can answer any questions he has about Sand Seals and that she is skilled at training them.<ref>{{Cite|If you need to know anything about {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}, I should be your first stop.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|If you have any questions about {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}, come talk to me. I'm quite skilled at training them!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

When Link asks about Sand Seals, Frelly explains that they are native to the [[Gerudo Desert Gateway]].<ref>{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Sand seals}} are animals native to the Gerudo Desert Gateway.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> She then says that it is dangerous to cross the Gerudo Desert on foot, but one would breeze along by crossing with a Sand Seal.<ref>{{Cite|It's quite dangerous to cross the desert on foot, but if you have a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}, you'll breeze right along!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> This has made them very important to the Gerudo.<ref>{{Cite|Obviously, {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} are incredibly important to the Gerudo people.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks Frelly how to catch a Sand Seal, she tells him that they are sensitive to sound and that they must be approached very slowly.<ref>{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Sand seals}} are especially sensitive to the sounds around them. The trick is to approach very, very slowly...|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> However, she points out that most Gerudo simply rent a Sand Seal to avoid the hassle of catching one.<ref>{{Cite|It's a pain in the neck, though, so most Gerudo just end up renting one instead.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

If Link asks how to ride a Sand Seal, Frelly tells him that he only needs a [[Shield]], since Sand Seals will simply go in whatever direction he steers them.<ref>{{Cite|Steering a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}} is really easy—they'll go in whatever direction you want. But! You need a {{Color BotW|Red|shield}} to sand-seal surf, so don't forget about that.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> She recommends that the best way to learn is to try it.<ref>{{Cite|Just giving it a shot is best, but if there's anything you don't get, let me know! You know, the best way for you to learn how to do this is by just doing it!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> Frelly also tells Link to come by her shop in Gerudo Town to rent a Sand Seal if he has trouble catching one,<ref>{{Cite|If you're having a hard time catching one, come by my shop in Gerudo Town. I rent out sand seals and...oh.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> but quickly remembers that men are not allowed inside the Town's walls.<ref>{{Cite|You're a voe... My shop is inside the town walls, so you won't be able to get in...|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> If Link is wearing the [[Gerudo Outfit]], Frelly tells him to look for the big [[Sand-Seal Statue]] to find her shop in Gerudo Town.<ref>{{Cite|My shop in Gerudo Town has a big {{Color BotW|Blue|sand-seal statue}} on it. Just look for that, and you'll find me!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

If Link speaks to Frelly at the Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth, she says that Sand Seals are the best way to cross the Gerudo Desert.<ref>{{Cite|Vasaaq! If you are hoping to cross the vast Gerudo Desert, {{Color BotW|Blue|sand-seal}} surfing is the way to do it!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> She offers Link a Sand Seal rental for 20 [[Rupee]]s, but if he does not have any Shields, she will include a [[Wooden Shield]] for a total of 50 Rupees.<ref>{{Cite|It's only {{Color BotW|Red|20 rupees}} to rent one! Need a shield, too? Just pay {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}! What do you say?|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>

If Link wishes to rent a Sand Seal, he will tell Frelly to "seal the deal", which is a pun that confuses her.<ref>{{Cite|[Let's seal the deal!] What? Is that some kind of slang? {{Small|I wonder if it's just a thing outside Gerudo Town...}}|Frelly|BotW}}</ref> After hearing this, Frelly herself will start to use Sand Seal puns, such as telling Link that it would be a "sealious mistake" to travel the Gerudo Desert without a Sand Seal and saying "seal you another time" when Link makes a rental.<ref>{{Cite|Anyway... The Gerudo Desert is vast. It'd be a sealious mistake not to take a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}} if you're traveling out of town.|Frelly|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Seal you another time! Sav'orq!|Frelly|BotW}}</ref>
